# Overview

This code takes the WUMI 3 data compiled by Park Williams and creates a
unified fire perimeter dataset for use by the wildfire community. A full
description of the WUMI3 dataset can be found in the
publication: https://doi.org/10.5194/essd-17-7359-2025.


# Setup

```{r setup-chunk, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}

if(!requireNamespace("here", quietly = TRUE)) {
  install.packages("here")
}
library(here)

source(here::here("utils", "functions.R"))

install_load_packages(c("sf",
                            "here",
                            "httr",
                            "purrr",
                            "glue",
                            "vapour",
                            "patchwork",
                            "scales",
                            "zip",
                            "gridExtra",
                            "grid",
                            "tidyverse"))

dir_raw <- here::here("data", "raw")
dir_derived <- here::here("data", "derived")
dir_ensure(c(dir_raw,
           dir_derived))

```

# Access, unzip, and load main fires and lists

```{r data}
##########################################################
# USER-SET PARAMETERS

# Dryad doesn't play nice with vsi, so you need to download the data MANUALLY
# You need the zips ending in "final_wildfire_lists" and "fire_maps". Place both zip files in the 'data/raw/' directory. The code will unzip them.

wumi_version_name <- "WUMI2024a"
#data_location <- "https://datadryad.org/share/Ox4oxdwdrhkmjUTpke7QgkfF--h-RLRbmMzGBhSmOr4"

# To document what data was used
fire_maps_link <- "https://datadryad.org/downloads/file_stream/4224445?share=Ox4oxdwdrhkmjUTpke7QgkfF--h-RLRbmMzGBhSmOr4"
final_wildfire_lists_link <- "https://datadryad.org/downloads/file_stream/4224444?share=Ox4oxdwdrhkmjUTpke7QgkfF--h-RLRbmMzGBhSmOr4"

wumi_lists_zip <- here(dir_raw, "WUMI2024a_final_wildfire_lists.zip")
wumi_maps_zip <- here(dir_raw, "fire_maps.zip")

##########################################################

#Unzip - NOTE that unzipping the maps zip may take a while given the large number of files
wumi_lists_unzipped <- safe_unzip(zip_path = wumi_lists_zip,
                         extract_to = dir_raw,
                         recursive = FALSE,
                         keep_zip = TRUE,
                         return_all_paths = FALSE,
                         full_contents_check = FALSE)

wumi_maps_unzipped <- safe_unzip(zip_path = wumi_maps_zip,
                         extract_to = dir_raw,
                         recursive = TRUE,
                         keep_zip = TRUE,
                         return_all_paths = FALSE,
                         full_contents_check = FALSE)

# Get main fires file
no_subfires_file <- list.files(
  path = wumi_lists_unzipped,
  pattern = "_no_subfires\\.txt$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

wumi_main_fires <- readr::read_csv(
  file = no_subfires_file,
  show_col_types = FALSE
)



```

# Primary operating functions

```{r functions}

prioritize_wumi_perimeter <- function(id) {
  
  ba_mtbs_file <- here::here(wumi_maps_unzipped, id, "burnarea_mtbs.shp")
  ba_calfire_file <- here::here(wumi_maps_unzipped, id, "burnarea_calfire.shp")
  ba_wfigs_file <- here::here(wumi_maps_unzipped, id, "burnarea_wfigs.shp")
  ba_usgs_file <- here::here(wumi_maps_unzipped, id, "burnarea_usgs")
  ba_iafph_file <- here::here(wumi_maps_unzipped, id, "burnarea_iafph.shp")
  ba_circle_file <- here::here(wumi_maps_unzipped, id, "burnarea_circle.shp")
  
  priority_file <- ""

  if(file.exists(ba_mtbs_file)) {
    priority_file <- ba_mtbs_file
  } else if(file.exists(ba_calfire_file)) {
    priority_file <- ba_calfire_file
  } else if(file.exists(ba_wfigs_file)) {
    priority_file <- ba_wfigs_file
  } else if(file.exists(ba_usgs_file)) {
    priority_file <- ba_usgs_file
  } else if(file.exists(ba_iafph_file)) {
    priority_file <- ba_iafph_file
  } else {
    priority_file <- ba_circle_file
  }
  
  return(priority_file)
}


load_file_add_dats <- function(prioritized_file) {
  p_file_name <- basename(prioritized_file)
  perimeter_type <- switch(p_file_name,
                           "burnarea_mtbs.shp" = "MTBS",
                           "burnarea_calfire.shp" = "CALFIRE",
                           "burnarea_wfigs.shp" = "WFIGS",
                           "burnarea_usgs.shp" = "USGS",
                           "burnarea_iafph.shp" = "IAFPH",
                           "burnarea_circle.shp" = "CIRCLE",
                           NA)
  p <- sf::st_read(prioritized_file,
                   quiet = TRUE) |>
    dplyr::mutate(perimeter_type = perimeter_type,
                  fire_year = lubridate::year(date)) |>
    sf::st_set_crs("ESRI:102039")
  return(p)
}


```

# Use primary operating functions

```{r operate}
ids <- wumi_main_fires$fireid
#ids <- ids[1:100] #For testing

# Use functions and rename since columns got shortened in .shp export from Park
prioritized_perims <- ids |>
  purrr::map(prioritize_wumi_perimeter) |>
  purrr::map(load_file_add_dats) |>
  dplyr::bind_rows() |>
  dplyr::rename(poly_area_ha = poly_area_h,
                burn_area_ha = burn_area_h,
                object_ID_wfaip = object_ID_w,
                object_ID_fpafod = object_ID_f,
                object_ID_wfigs = object_ID_w.1,
                object_ID_calfire = object_ID_c,
                object_ID_usgs = object_ID_u,
                object_ID_iafph = object_ID_i,
                cause_human_or_natural = cause_human,
                cause_specific = cause_speci)


```

# Get some basic stats for user

```{r stats}

# Total events by perimeter_type
event_count <- prioritized_perims |>
  sf::st_drop_geometry() |>
  dplyr::group_by(perimeter_type) |>
  dplyr::summarise(number_of_events = n())
event_count

# Total area by perimeter_type
area_totals <- prioritized_perims |>
  sf::st_drop_geometry() |>
  dplyr::group_by(perimeter_type) |>
  dplyr::summarise(total_area = sum(poly_area_ha))
area_totals






p1 <- ggplot(event_count, aes(x = "", y = number_of_events, fill = perimeter_type)) +
  geom_col(width = 1, color = "white") +
  coord_polar(theta = "y") +
  labs(title = "Number of Events", fill = "Perimeter Type") +
  theme_void() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

p2 <- ggplot(area_totals, aes(x = "", y = total_area, fill = perimeter_type)) +
  geom_col(width = 1, color = "white") +
  coord_polar(theta = "y") +
  labs(title = "Total Area (ha)", fill = "Perimeter Type") +
  theme_void() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

# -- format tables a bit for readability --
event_count_fmt <- event_count %>%
  arrange(desc(number_of_events)) %>%
  mutate(number_of_events = comma(number_of_events))

area_totals_fmt <- area_totals %>%
  arrange(desc(total_area)) %>%
  mutate(total_area = comma(total_area, accuracy = 1))

# -- make table grobs --
tg1 <- tableGrob(event_count_fmt, rows = NULL,
                 theme = ttheme_minimal(base_size = 10,
                                        padding = unit(c(3, 4), "mm")))
tg2 <- tableGrob(area_totals_fmt, rows = NULL,
                 theme = ttheme_minimal(base_size = 10,
                                        padding = unit(c(3, 4), "mm")))

# -- wrap tables so patchwork can layout them like plots --
g1 <- patchwork::wrap_elements(full = tg1)
g2 <- patchwork::wrap_elements(full = tg2)

# -- combine: pies + stacked tables on the right --
combined_side <- (p1 | p2 | (g1 / g2)) +
  plot_layout(widths = c(1, 1, 0.9), guides = "collect") &
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

combined_side

ggsave(here("figs", glue("{wumi_version_name}_area_number.png")))


# Area density by perimeter type
ggplot() + 
  geom_density(data = prioritized_perims,
                 aes(x = poly_area_ha, color = perimeter_type)) +
  labs(title = glue::glue("Density plots of fire areas by perimeter type in {wumi_version_name}")) +
  scale_x_log10()
ggsave(here("figs", glue("{wumi_version_name}_perim_type_density.png")))

# Total perimeters
print(glue::glue("There are {nrow(prioritized_perims)} events in the total {wumi_version_name} unified main fire set."))

```

# Write out

```{r write}

cgpkg_fl <- here::here(dir_derived, glue::glue("{wumi_version_name}_main_fires_unified_with_circles.gpkg"))
sf::st_write(prioritized_perims,
             cgpkg_fl,
             append = FALSE)

for_shp <- prioritized_perims |>
  dplyr::select(fireid, date, fire_year) |>
  dplyr::mutate(day_of_yr = lubridate::yday(as.Date(date)))
st_write_shp(shp = for_shp,
             location = dir_derived,
             filename = glue::glue("{wumi_version_name}_main_fires_unified_with_circles"),
             zip_only = TRUE,
             overwrite = TRUE)
cshp_fl <- here::here(dir_derived, glue::glue("{wumi_version_name}_main_fires_unified_with_circles.zip"))


prioritized_perims_no_circles <- prioritized_perims |>
  filter(perimeter_type != "CIRCLE")

ncgpkg_fl <- here::here(dir_derived, glue::glue("{wumi_version_name}_main_fires_unified_no_circles.gpkg"))
sf::st_write(prioritized_perims_no_circles,
             ncgpkg_fl,
             append = FALSE)

for_shp <- prioritized_perims_no_circles |>
  dplyr::select(fireid, date, fire_year) |>
  dplyr::mutate(day_of_yr = lubridate::yday(as.Date(date)))
st_write_shp(shp = for_shp,
             location = dir_derived,
             filename = glue::glue("{wumi_version_name}_main_fires_unified_no_circles"),
             zip_only = TRUE,
             overwrite = TRUE)
ncshp_fl <- here::here(dir_derived, glue::glue("{wumi_version_name}_main_fires_unified_no_circles.zip"))

```

# Package with metadata

```{r}

column_descriptions <- c(
  "Fire ID from WUMI",
  "The dataset that the perimeter data came from",
  "The reporting agency",
  "The name of the fire, if available",
  "The date of the fire, if available",
  "Latitude",
  "Longitude",
  "Calculated area of the polygon",
  "Actual burned area within the polygon, if available",
  "Name in MTBS dataset",
  "ID in MTBS dataset",
  "Interagency IRWIN ID",
  "FOD ID",
  "FPA ID",
  "Object ID in FOD database",
  "Object ID in FPAFOD database",
  "Object ID in WFIGS database",
  "Object ID in CALFIRE database",
  "Object ID in USGS database",
  "Object ID in IAFPH database",
  "Human vs natural cause (if known)",
  "More specific cause (if known)",
  "The type of perimeter used in the prioritization scheme (added at unification step)",
  "The year of the fire if available (added at unification step)",
  "Geospatial delineation")

package_with_metadata(data_file_path = c(cgpkg_fl, cshp_fl, ncgpkg_fl, ncshp_fl),
                      column_names = names(prioritized_perims),
                      column_descriptions = column_descriptions,
                      overall_description = glue::glue("This is a unified perimeter set for the {wumi_version_name} dataset. The WUMI3 dataset is created by Park Williams, and is generated as a set of individual shapefiles. To streamline use by the wildfire community, this dataset consists of a unified set of perimeters for the 'main fires' in the dataset. ('Main fires' meaning that some of the events are complex fires composed of multiple smaller events.) The WUMI3 dataset incorporates data from multiple different sources. The perimeters here have been selected using the prioritization scheme suggested in the WUMI3 publication (in order of preference: MTBS, CalFire, WFIGS, USGS, IAFPH).\n\nThe dataset has been generated in shapefile (zipped) and .gpkg format, with two versions of each: '...with_circles' and '...no_circles'. The former includes estimated circular fire perimeters generated by Williams et al. for fires without manually derived perimeters (see manuscript for details). The latter provides all perimeters except for the circular estimated perimeters.\n\nAll columns in the generated perimeter set are from the original WUMI3 data unless otherwise specified.\n\n## Original publication\nWilliams, A. P., Juang, C. S., & Short, K. C. (2025). The Western United States MTBS-Interagency database of large wildfires, 1984–2024 (WUMI2024a). Earth System Science Data, 17(12), 7359–7372. https://doi.org/10.5194/essd-17-7359-2025"),
                      author = "Tyler L. McIntosh",
                      github_repo = "https://github.com/TylerLMcIntosh/cbi-module",
                      out_dir = dir_derived,
                      data_name_full = glue::glue("{wumi_version_name} unified main fire perimeters"),
                      data_name_file = glue::glue("{wumi_version_name}_main_fires_unified"),
                      test = FALSE,
                      compression_level = 9)




```
